title: Human attestations
description: Human attestation records (TOML, human-owned, D43/F11). Each attestation is bound to fingerprints and evidence ids; whether a binding is current or stale is computed by `review attestations` and never written here (so there is no status field). `kind` keeps the owner's check (tier 4), the expert's review (tier 5: recorded separately, gates nothing, D43/F06) and a provisional baseline (D44) apart.

id.description: Unique, chosen by the owner, never reused.

kind.description: `provisional-baseline`: an interface baseline, not a fidelity check; `owner-check`: the owner's one-time check (tier 4); `expert-review`: the expert's review (tier 5, gates nothing).

by.description: Who attests: the owner for a baseline or an owner check, the expert for an expert review.

scope.description: What exactly is attested, in the attester's words.

binding.description: What the attestation is bound to.

allOf.description: An expert review is by the expert; the other kinds are by the owner.

binding.description: One binding: a declaration at given fingerprints, with the evidence records that hold them.

digest.description: Optional: if set, a digest change makes the binding stale; empty means unset.

evidence.description: Evidence ids (at least one): the records the attestation rests on.

decl.description: An absolute Lean declaration id as `Name.toString` prints it (the ids `tracker graph` uses).

evidenceId.description: An evidence id: `<kind>:<rest>` with kind `fingerprint`, `readback` or `comparator`.

sha256.description: A SHA-256 hash: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex digits.
